```{=html}
<!-- Navbar -->
{{< include _navbar.html >}}

<!-- Role selection page -->
<div class="auth-page">
  <div class="auth-card" style="max-width: 440px;">
    <img src="assets/logo.png" alt="AAIC Logo" class="auth-logo">
    <h2>I am a...</h2>
    <p class="auth-subtitle">Choose how you would like to continue</p>

    <div class="role-choices">
      <a href="login-student.html" class="role-choice-btn">
        <span class="role-choice-icon">&#x1F393;</span>
        <span class="role-choice-label">Registered Student</span>
      </a>

      <a href="login-teacher.html" class="role-choice-btn">
        <span class="role-choice-icon">&#x1F4CB;</span>
        <span class="role-choice-label">Registered Teacher</span>
      </a>

      <div class="role-divider">
        <span>or</span>
      </div>

      <a href="#" id="guestBtn" class="role-choice-btn guest">
        <span class="role-choice-icon">&#x1F441;</span>
        <span class="role-choice-label">Log in as Guest</span>
      </a>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
document.getElementById('guestBtn').addEventListener('click', function(e) {
  e.preventDefault();
  // Set guest mode in sessionStorage
  sessionStorage.setItem('guestMode', 'true');
  // Redirect to modules page
  window.location.href = 'modules.html';
});
</script>
